# GitHub collaboration

## Responsibility and structure

- `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`: bug, feature, and documentation forms plus chooser configuration.
- `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`: change context, verification, screenshots, and contributor checklist.

## Boundaries and verification

Keep GitHub collaboration configuration here; community policy belongs in root documents. No CI workflow exists yet. Validate issue forms as YAML and inspect their rendered forms after publishing to GitHub. Follow `docs/OPEN_SOURCE_CHECKLIST.md` for owner-managed settings.
